standard.summary: 训练图像数据集的目录路径。目录下的图像文件（.png/.jpg 等）和对应的图说文件（.txt/.caption）构成训练数据集。
standard.effect: 支持绝对路径和相对路径。可以包含子目录（需要图说文件）。data_transfer_profile 记录数据加载的耗时统计，用于诊断 I/O 瓶颈。
standard.whenToUse: 每次训练必须设置。建议为每次训练实验使用独立的数据目录。
standard.avoidWhen: 数据目录中混入非训练文件（如 .DS_Store、Thumbs.db）可能被误识别，建议清理干净。

standard_en.summary: The directory path of the training image dataset. The image files (.png/.jpg and so on) in that directory together with their caption files (.txt/.caption) make up the training dataset.
standard_en.effect: Absolute and relative paths both work. Subdirectories are allowed (they need caption files). data_transfer_profile records data-loading timing statistics, for diagnosing an I/O bottleneck.
standard_en.whenToUse: It has to be set for every training run. Using a separate data directory per experiment is advisable.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Non-training files mixed into the data directory (.DS_Store, Thumbs.db) may be misidentified, so cleaning it out is advisable.

advanced.principle: 训练器遍历数据目录，寻找支持格式的图像（png/jpg/webp）及同名图说文件（caption_extension 设定的扩展名）。子目录支持需要图说文件或子目录名被识别为概念名。data_backend 选择图像读取后端（pillow / opencv），影响读取速度和格式支持。
advanced.tradeoffs: 数据在 NVMe 上训练速度最快（I/O 延迟低）；HDD 上大数据集可能成为 I/O 瓶颈（配合缓存可改善）。

advanced_en.principle: The trainer walks the data directory looking for images in supported formats (png/jpg/webp) plus same-named caption files (with the extension set by caption_extension). Subdirectory support requires caption files, or the subdirectory name being recognized as a concept name. data_backend selects the image reading backend (pillow / opencv), affecting read speed and format support.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Training on NVMe data is fastest (low I/O latency); on HDD, large datasets can become the I/O bottleneck (mitigated with caching).
